title: Contracted Disposal Charges by Equipment Class — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
**Contracted disposal rates.** For the haul-away of equipment that Bridgewell replaced under a Homeowner Service Contract, the disposal charge depends on the equipment class removed:

| Replaced item | Disposal charge |
|---|---|
| refrigerator or cooling system (its refrigerant must be recovered before disposal) | 55.00 |
| water heater or heating system | 45.00 |
| any other item | 30.00 |

The class is the covered item on the replacement authorization that the completion report closes.

*Rate lookups (hypothetical):* a replaced central air conditioning unit — 55.00; a replaced furnace — 45.00; a replaced dishwasher — 30.00.
